---
title: "2 Kings"
---

# 2 Kings

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 Kings traces the decline and exile of Israel and Judah because of persistent unfaithfulness. The book demonstrates God's justice while preserving hope through His covenant promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Is it because there is no God in Israel?</div>

### Why This Verse

Elijah confronts idolatry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Ahaziah's inquiry of Baal-zebub and Elijah's response. The key verse demonstrates that God alone is the source of truth and guidance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 2:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Elijah went up by a whirlwind</div>

### Why This Verse

Elijah's translation to heaven

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Elijah's departure and Elisha's succession. The key verse emphasizes the continuation of God's work through faithful servants.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 3:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Ye shall not see wind or rain</div>

### Why This Verse

God's miraculous provision

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records God's deliverance of Israel through Elisha's prophecy. The key verse highlights God's provision even when circumstances seem impossible.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 4:43</div>

<div class="identifier">They shall eat and have some left</div>

### Why This Verse

Memorable miracle of provision

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains several miracles through Elisha. The key verse demonstrates God's compassion and power to meet human needs.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 5:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Naaman was clean</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous healing account

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Naaman's healing from leprosy. The key verse emphasizes humble faith and obedience to God's instructions.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 6:16</div>

<div class="identifier">They that be with us are more than they that be with them</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the book's best-known verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records miraculous deliverances and divine protection. The key verse reveals God's unseen presence surrounding His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 7:9</div>

<div class="identifier">This day is a day of good tidings</div>

### Why This Verse

The lepers' realization

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes God's miraculous provision during a famine. The key verse highlights God's ability to reverse hopeless situations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 8:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Is thy servant a dog?</div>

### Why This Verse

Hazael prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records prophecies concerning future kings and nations. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereign knowledge of coming events.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 9:22</div>

<div class="identifier">What peace, so long as Jezebel's whoredoms remain?</div>

### Why This Verse

Jehu's confrontation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jehu's anointing and judgment upon Ahab's house. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness to fulfill His word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 10:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou hast done well in executing what is right</div>

### Why This Verse

Jehu commended

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Jehu's destruction of Baal worship. The key verse highlights zeal for reform while exposing incomplete obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 11:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Jehoiada made a covenant</div>

### Why This Verse

National renewal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the preservation and coronation of Joash. The key verse demonstrates God's protection of the Davidic line.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 12:15</div>

<div class="identifier">They dealt faithfully</div>

### Why This Verse

Integrity in stewardship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the repair of the Temple under Joash. The key verse emphasizes faithful stewardship of God's house.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 13:21</div>

<div class="identifier">The dead man revived</div>

### Why This Verse

Remarkable Elisha miracle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Israel's decline yet continued mercy from God. The key verse highlights God's compassion despite covenant unfaithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 14:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Fathers shall not be put to death for children</div>

### Why This Verse

Important justice principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the reigns of Amaziah and Jeroboam II. The key verse demonstrates how pride can lead to downfall.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 15:35</div>

<div class="identifier">The people still sacrificed in high places</div>

### Why This Verse

Persistent spiritual problem

### Chapter Insight

This chapter summarizes several kings and increasing instability. The key verse reveals the consequences of persistent spiritual compromise.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 16:3</div>

<div class="identifier">He made his son pass through the fire</div>

### Why This Verse

Ahaz's apostasy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Ahaz's idolatry and alliance with Assyria. The key verse highlights the danger of trusting human solutions over God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 17:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Turn from your evil ways</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of prophetic warnings

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the fall of the Northern Kingdom of Israel. The key verse explains that judgment came because of persistent disobedience and idolatry.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 18:5</div>

<div class="identifier">He trusted in the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah's defining characteristic

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces Hezekiah's reforms and faithfulness. The key verse emphasizes trust in God rather than political alliances.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 19:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Save us, that all kingdoms may know You</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah's prayer

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records God's deliverance of Jerusalem from Assyria. The key verse demonstrates God's power to save those who trust Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 20:5</div>

<div class="identifier">I have heard thy prayer</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah healed

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Hezekiah's illness, healing, and failure. The key verse highlights both God's mercy and the danger of pride.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 21:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Manasseh shed innocent blood</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of his wickedness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the wicked reign of Manasseh. The key verse reveals the devastating effects of prolonged rebellion against God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 22:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Great is the wrath of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Response to discovering the Law

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the discovery of the Book of the Law under Josiah. The key verse emphasizes the transformative power of God's word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 23:25</div>

<div class="identifier">No king like Josiah</div>

### Why This Verse

Josiah's unparalleled devotion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Josiah's reforms and covenant renewal. The key verse highlights wholehearted devotion to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 24:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Surely at the commandment of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Judah's fall explained

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Judah's decline under Babylonian pressure. The key verse demonstrates the fulfillment of God's warnings through the prophets.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">2 Kings 25:27</div>

<div class="identifier">Evil-merodach lifted up Jehoiachin's head</div>

### Why This Verse

Hope amid exile

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the fall of Jerusalem and the exile. The key verse marks the tragic culmination of generations of covenant unfaithfulness while leaving a small note of hope.
:::
